<details>
This file is a standard Arch Linux package install hook (vtium.install) containing only informational post-install, post-upgrade, pre-remove, and post-remove message functions. The references to /var/lib/vtium/console and /etc/systemd/system are within the application's own data and systemd integration scope, which is normal for a VT/console package. LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBuild uses a pinned git tag (`v0.1.0-alpha.1`) of the package's own upstream repository, fetched via a signed clone (`?signed`), with validpgpkeys set to the maintainers' PGP key. The `sha256sums=('SKIP')` is expected for VCS sources and is a trust/hygiene choice, not malice. `prepare()` only runs `cargo fetch --locked` against the crate registry for the upstream `vtium` project; `build()` invokes `make` (vtium's Makefile) and installs into `$pkgdir`. All network activity and file operations are confined to the package's declared upstream source and standard build tooling. No exfiltration, backdoors, injected code, reverse shells, or unexpected downloads are present.
</details>
